segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers generally report a matte to semi-matte finish that holds up through sweat and humidity, though a couple describe the product feeling heavy, hard to remove, and prone to make foundation slip off in hot, humid conditions.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the crème feels smooth and moisturizing without flaking, though one notes it can dry her skin out by the end of winter days unless she adds a rich moisturizer.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (including dry-combo and oily-combo) describe it staying matte through sweat and wear well without emphasizing oily zones.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with rosacea or acne, most often report no irritation, itching, or breakouts, though one sensitive reviewer found it felt greasy and hard to remove and one found the tint too dark/orange for her.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention mature or aging skin (50+, menopausal, or describing themselves as older) report it sits well over moisturizer, handles hot flashes without lifting, and gives skin a smoother, less lined look.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it against fine lines and uneven tone report the tint blurs texture and lines and gives an even, glowing look; no negative reports on aging skin specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it feels hydrating and non-drying, even in winter, though two specifically report their skin felt dry or tight by day's end despite the product.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or general redness report it calms or hides redness and causes no irritation or hot skin sensation, with no dissent noted.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report it does not compromise or irritate the skin barrier, including those sensitive to niacinamide or chemical filters; one reviewer's sensitive skin still found the texture heavy and hard to remove.
concerns.spots: Reviewers mention it blurs dark spots, melasma, and uneven pigmentation, giving a more even-toned look; no negative reports on this concern.
concerns.blemishes: Acne-prone reviewers largely report no new breakouts or irritation even after switching from other mineral sunscreens that caused reactions, though one reviewer describes the product as feeling greasy in a way that made her hesitant despite no breakouts, and one found it did not remove easily, which she felt made pores or skin feel congested by day's end.
concerns.oiliness: Most oily-skin reviewers report a matte finish that lasts through the day, but a couple describe it looking oily/shiny by mid-day in heat and humidity or interfering with makeup adherence.

extraits.texte: I love this sunscreen. I have rosacea and acne-prone skin. I love that it doesn't irritate my skin or make my dry skin stand out, which happens all the time with sunscreens that leave a white cast. I've tried quite a few sunscreens from other brands (and another from MD) and I keep coming back to this one. I would LOVE if they came out with a larger size and one that had SPF 50!!

The MDSolarSciences mineral tinted creme SPF 30 is fantastic and better than I ever imagined! Please do not change a thing with the formula! I have purposefully wait 1 month before giving a review because my skin is extremely sensitive and acne prone and almost all mineral sunscreens cause acne or bad reactions (I have tried over 6 of the top mineral SPF name brands in the last year and all caused bad breakouts or itchy red skin within a few days of use) ‚ I have had no reactionary skin issues with this product. This product is a game changer and checks all the boxes of what I have been desiring in a daily SPF creme; namely (1) cosmetically elegant with a matte finish (I hate the shiny effect of most sunscreens) (2) easy to apply and blend (3) mineral formula that is oil and paraben free with short list of high quality ingredients and recommended by the EWG as a safe product (4) tinted to be able to wear in place of a foundation on daily basis and (5) formula designed for sensitive acne prone skin. I love that I have both SPF protection and antioxidants such as Vitamin C and green tea extract in this formula and that this formula does NOT contain Vitamin E or niacinamide (2 ingredients that irritate my acne prone skin). extraits.texte: I have been using this sunscreen for several years. I have tried to switch to other sunscreens which have made headlines but I keep coming back to this one because I LOVE how it creates a beautiful flawless base for makeup. It evens out my uneven skin tone, creates a smooth texture, and minimizes my pores. I have sensitive skin and I don't break out. It is perfect for hot summer days and through gym sessions. It keeps my makeup intact. Others have accentuated my pores, made my face look darker throughout the day or looked greasy. The only issue I have during the winter months is that it dries out my skin by end of the day. My skin feels tight and dry. I now use a rich moisturizer and spray my face to combat that issue.

I'll start off with this is a beautiful feeling sunscreen. it has a mousse texture and a pretty neutral tint. it's really moisterizing too. I prefer mineral sunscreens cause chemical ones burn my eyes so I was excited for this one. but, for me personally it felt a little heavy on my skin. I don't wear make up so I can't say how it layers, but it didn't pill or nothing. it just felt heavy on my oily skin, especially in humidity. and I found it to be difficult to try to remove as well, which I guess means it'd be really effective against the sun but my sensitive skin didn't appreciate the extra effect needed to remove. I still think this is a good sunscreen, it just wasn't for me personally.

extraits.texte: I like the tint, it works very well for my medium tan skintone. It's also very easy to spread and feels great. Doesn't look oily or wet/shiny. But it doesn't work with makeup. It tends to slip and slide with sweat and oiliness, and makeup has a hard time adhering to begin with. I have oily skin, and live in hot, humid weather. This I'd definitely not for me. Wish I knew. It would be great for people in cooler climates that don't wear base makeup.

I have sensitive, acne-prone skin and this is my go-to SPF. Doesn't leave you looking greasy and is the perfect primer for other silicone-based foundations. My skin type is dry-combo and this works at all times of the year. Leaves your skin feeling silky and just a touch mattified without being drying at all.
